# NT OFFICIAL SAFETY MANUAL ## SECTOR APPALIA MAJORIS ## CHAPLAIN’S EYES ONLY
In addition to the standard safety manual, Nanotrasen finds it prescient to inform you of these additional possible threats and how to react to them.
## Arcana and Unsanctioned Worship
As the sole individual aboard your vessel that has been entrusted with abilities and understandings that fall outside that which the secular mind can perceive, Nanotrasen has deemed it necessary that you are granted additional information regarding the nature of those that worship and follow false deities.
### The Mansus
Though current conceptual understanding of the Mansus is lacking due to its noneuclidian nature, there exists the possibility that some individuals may find themselves particularly driven to devote their mortal lives to the study of this false afterlife. Though these individuals are not easily identified, the fragments of their work can be seen by those perceptive to it. If you observe areas on your vessel where time and/or space seem particularly undefined, it is recommended that you consult the nearest member of [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color].
### Cults
Groups of unsanctioned worshipers are unlikely to congregate aboard your vessel, but you should still be aware of their existence. Specific targets of their worship are highly varied both in presentation and in level of sacrilege. If you have any indication that one or more of your coworkers have devoted themselves to a false prophet or prophets, you are encouraged to notify your [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] department to look further into the matter.
Should it be necessary, you may be called upon to take up your ardent censer filled with holy water to purge the foul influence of the cult. [bold]Only attempt to cleanse those who are confirmed dissenters or face great consequence.[/bold]
## Hellish Influences
As the station’s authority on matters regarding the ever-creeping influence of Hell on our realm, it is imperative that you be able to identify how this influence tends to manifest aboard Nanotrasen’s vessels.
One such demonic manifestation is that of an imposing and highly armored being that appears from unobserved puddles of blood, human or otherwise. If sighted, this entity should be driven off your station with impunity and fervor.
There are examples of a more subtle and less violent manifestation of influence, that of a Satanic extension that serves to bargain for the everlasting souls of your flock. These entities are often associated with a black suit and large swathes of parchment, though their appearance may take that of another of your crew members. If left alone, these beings will leave your Vessel godless and corrupted. Seek these beings out by their true name and return them to their pit as soon as they are identified.
## Lost Souls
Though most are guided safely to the afterlife, not all of Nanotrasen’s employees peacefully pass on. There may be occurrences of poltergeist or other spiritual manifestations aboard your vessel. We urge you to isolate these spirits behind a thin layer of salt to allow their souls to be forcefully shunted to their predetermined eternal resting place.
